name: B10-0125/2025 (Renew) – Escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate end to the fighting in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. It condemns the occupation of Goma by M23 rebels and Rwandan troops and asks Rwanda to stop supporting them. It wants Goma airport reopened so aid can get in, humanitarian corridors opened, and sanctions on senior commanders. It also asks the EU to suspend its minerals deal with Rwanda and freeze some aid until Rwanda stops interfering. These are requests and condemnations, not decisions that change law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU to suspend the Rwanda minerals deal and freeze some aid.
- **Who it affects:** Rwanda's government and army, M23 commanders, and civilians in eastern Congo needing aid.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, Commission and both governments; they decide whether to act.
